BalconyLaundryArm450.manufacture: Generic unbranded fabricated outdoor laundry bracket: press-cut/formed galvanized steel arm plate with true through-holes, separate wall base, welded lower gusset, hinge boss/pin/washers and four exposed wall fastener heads. Not a replica of cited products.
BalconyLaundryArm450.mounting: Wall/base plate assumed anchored to sound structural substrate; anchor embedment, waterproofing and substrate-specific fastener specification are scene/building dependent and are not invented here.
BalconyLaundryArm450.orientation: Wall normal +X; arm projects +X; pole axis Z. Reference assembly keeps arm horizontal.
BalconyLaundryArm450.exposure: Outdoor balcony: sun, sky, wind and rain exposure; rear of base and wall interface sheltered.
BalconyLaundryArm450.aging: Maintained intact zinc. Micro roughness variation only; no arbitrary rust, streaks, dents or painted highlights before placement-specific causal history exists.
BalconyLaundryArm450.geometryVsMaterial: Arm silhouette, all three through-holes, gusset, hinge, washers, fastener heads and plate thickness are geometry. Zinc grain is material microvariation.
BalconyLaundryArm450.periodAccuracy: Generic unbranded construction chosen for scene plausibility. Current manufacturer dimensions are scale/construction references only, not evidence this exact configuration existed in the 1990s.
BalconyLaundryArm450.lod: LOD0/1/2/3 retain all manufactured components and all three true holes; only curved tessellation decreases.

LaundryPole2560.manufacture: Generic 32 mm outdoor laundry pole modeled as a hollow stainless tube with 1.2 mm wall, two inserted polymer end plugs/collars, rounded end caps and a separate metal stop collar/screw.
LaundryPole2560.mounting: Free supported in bracket holes; not fused to bracket. Reference assembly passes through outermost Ø38 mm holes.
LaundryPole2560.exposure: Outdoor sun/rain. Tube interior sheltered; polymer end caps exposed.
LaundryPole2560.aging: Dry maintained reference state; no baked highlights, water streaks or severe corrosion.
LaundryPole2560.geometryVsMaterial: Hollow tube bore, tube wall, end plug/collar, rounded caps and stop collar/screw are geometry. Fine steel/rubber surface variation is material.
LaundryPole2560.periodAccuracy: Current 32 mm × 2.56 m manufacturer pole information is used only as scale reference. Exact 1990s product claim is intentionally not made.
LaundryPole2560.lod: All tube/cap/stop components retained through LOD3.
